No external acquisition, citation snowballing, or adapted search applies to this closed fixture.

The amber supporting quote and claim omit the source's word “no.” This discrepancy is preserved at the user's explicit request. No correction or verification is represented as completed.

Both supplied synthetic source texts are available. No supplied text is missing, and no PDF drop-in is needed. This summary is kept here to preserve `synthesis.md` exactly.
